paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, David a-inn a a-om lai in zawlnei Nathan kiang ah David in, "Ngai in, kei sidar sing inn ah ka om a, himahleh TOUPA thukhun bawm puanzak nuai maimah ah a-om a," achi hi.
heading: David Kiang A Nathan Thuchiam / (2 Sam 7.1-17)

paite: Nathan in David kiang ah, "Na lungsim a na vei bangtak in hih in; Pathian na kiang ah lah a-om ngal a," achi hi.
Huai zan mah in hichi ahong hi a, Nathan kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi,
"Ka sikha David va hilh in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ka omna ding in nang inn na hon lamsak ding ahi kei;
Israel suante Aigupta gam a kipan ka pikhiak a kipan tutan in inn lam ah ka om kei a; puanin leh biakbuk ah ka om zel hi.
Israel tengteng toh ka paina himhim uah leng ka mite vak ding a thu ka piak Israelte vaihawmte kiang ah, bangziak a sidar sing inn hon lamsak lou, ka chi ngei a hia?'
"Huaiziak in ka sikha David kiang ah huchi in gen in, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi, belam tatna mun a kipan na belamching lai ka mi Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in ka hon la a;
na paina peuhmah ah na kiang ah ka om zel a, na melmate ka hon hihmansak zel hi; lei a mithupi mahmahte bang in min thupitak ka hon bawlsak sin hi.

Ka mi Israelte a ding in mun ka sepsak ding a, kisuan nawn lou a amau tuam mun a a-om gige theihna ding un amaute ka phutkip ding a, tuma lam a bang in, migiloute'n amaute ahihgenthei nawn kei ding uh;
ka mi Israelte tung a vaihawmte ka seh hun a kipan. Huan na melma tengteng leng ka zahlaksak lai ding hi. Huai lou leng TOUPA'N inn khat ahon lamsak lai ding chih ka hon hilh ahi.
Huchi in na ni abei a, na pi-le-pute kiang a na pai hun chiang in, hichi ahi ding a, na nung a na suan na tapate lak a mi ka tungding ding a; agam ka hihkip ding hi.
Ama'n inn ahon lamsak ding a; alaltutphah tangtawn in ka hihkip ding.
Huchi in apa ka hi ding a, amah ka tapa ahi ding; ka zahngaihna na ma a ompa a kipan a ka lakmang bang in, amah zaw ka lamang kei ding hi;
Ka inn ah leh ka gam ah amah tangtawn in ka dingkipsak ding a, alaltutphah tangtawn a hihkip ahi ding," chi in.
Huai thute tengteng leh huai kilakna bang geih in Nathan in David kiang ah agen hi.
Huchi in kumpipa David alut a, TOUPA ma ah atu a, "Aw TOUPA Pathian, kua ahia ka hih a, ka inkote leng kua ahia ahih ua, hichi tantan na hon pi?
heading: David Kipahthu Genna Thumna / (2 Sam 7.18-29)

paite: Aw Pathian, huaite leng nang mitmuh in thil neuchik phet zaw ahi a; himahleh aw TOUPA Pathian, na sikha inkuan hong omdan ding thu kum tampi sung a ding na na genta a, milian bang in na hon sep lai a, aw TOUPA Pathian.
Na sikha pahtawi a a-om tungtang thu ah David in na kiang ah bang agen tuan nawn dia? Na sikha lah na theitel mahmah hi.
Aw TOUPA na sikha ziak in nangmah lungsim a pawt bang zel in hiai thil thupi mahmah theisak ding in thil thupi mahmahte na hihta hi.
Aw TOUPA ka theih un nang bang mahmah a-om kei ua, nang lou ngal Pathian himhim leng a-om sam kei hi.

Aigupta gam a kipan na tatkhiak a na mite ma a namdangte zahlaksak a, thil thupitak leh lauhuaitak hih a min thupitak bawlsak ding a Pathian in amah mite a dia ahon tatkhiak na mi Israelte bang mahmah leitung ah namdang kua a-om ua?
Na mi Israelte tangtawn a na mite ding in lah na bawlta ngal a; nang TOUPA amaute Pathian na hita hi.
"Huchi in aw TOUPA, na sikha tungtang thu leh a-inkote tungtang thu na gen tangtawn a ding in hihkip inla, na gensa bang in hih in.
Tangtawn in na min hihkip leh hihlet in om hen, 'Sepaihte' TOUPA Israel' Pathian, Israelte a dia Pathian mahmah ahi,' na sikha David inkote na ma ah hihkip in om uhen," chi in.
"Aw nang ka Pathian, na sikha kiang ah inkuan na dingsak ding chih na na puangta ngal a; huaiziak in na sikha in na kiang ah ka thum ngam lai ahi.
Aw TOUPA, nang zaw Pathian na hi a, hiai thil hoih na sikha na chiamta hi.
Na sikha inkote na ma a tangtawn a a-om gige theihna ding un na vualzawl a; aw TOUPA, na vualzawl zaw tangtawn a vualzawlna ahi,” achi hi.
